# TiltFold

An Android motion-driven fold and perspective experiment.

TiltFold turns device tilt into an in-app, two-panel hinge-style visual. It is built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with gravity-sensor input, accelerometer fallback, manual controls, and lifecycle-aware sampling.

## What this project is

- A small Android app for exploring a motion-responsive fold illusion.
- A two-panel perspective preview with 3D fold, soft surface, and flat modes.
- A sensor-driven interaction that can still be explored manually.

## What it is not

- It does not modify Android system UI or other applications.
- It does not physically bend the display.
- It is not a physically accurate flexible-screen or 3D mesh simulator.

## Project facts

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Platform | Android |
| Language | Kotlin |
| UI | Jetpack Compose |
| Minimum Android | 7.0 (API 24) |
| Compile / target SDK | 35 / 35 |
| JDK | 17 |
| Current app version | 2.0.0 |
| Distribution | APK via GitHub Releases |
